verdict.rationale: Paxos docs describe end-to-end orchestrations for converting USD↔stablecoins in one API call (mint/redeem), moving USD on/off platform via wire/CUBIX, and general conversions between supported assets, plus a Dashboard for platform management, giving a finance lead both API and dashboard paths for treasury operations. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard UI screenshots/steps for initiating a fiat/stablecoin transfer or rebalancing (dashboard docs are generic), and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
